checks.name: changed_same_size
checks.code:
from sync import sync_tree
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d);s=p/'src';s.mkdir();(s/'a').write_text('old');sync_tree(s,p/'dst');(s/'a').write_text('new');sync_tree(s,p/'dst');assert (p/'dst/a').read_text()=='new'

checks.name: symlink_rejected_without_manifest_change
checks.code:
from sync import sync_tree
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d);s=p/'src';s.mkdir();(s/'a').write_text('a');sync_tree(s,p/'dst');before=(p/'dst/.manifest.json').read_bytes();(s/'link').symlink_to('a')
 try:sync_tree(s,p/'dst')
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('link accepted')
 assert (p/'dst/.manifest.json').read_bytes()==before
